title: GTA6 Can't Win Golden Joysticks GOTY 2026 Due to Release Timing
description: GTA6 will miss out on the Golden Joysticks awards in 2026 because the ceremony takes place just days before its release. Read the full details here.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Misses Out on Golden Joysticks 2026 Awards Due to Release Date

As the gaming industry approaches the award season, anticipation is naturally high for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster. However, according to a recent report by gaming outlet Push Square, there is one major accolade that GTA 6 cannot win in 2026: the Console Game of the Year at the Golden Joysticks.

### The Timing Conflict Explained

The reason behind this exclusion is purely logistical. The Golden Joysticks awards show takes place eight days before the game is officially released. At the time of the event, reviewers will still be busy playing and evaluating the massive open-world title.

Furthermore, the submission window adds another hurdle. Nominations for the awards had to be officially submitted by August 28th. Because of these strict cut-off dates and the proximity to launch, GTA 6 missed the eligibility window entirely for this particular ceremony.

### Looking Ahead at the Award Season

While missing out on the Golden Joysticks means GTA 6 cannot sweep every single GOTY accolade this year, it remains one of the most anticipated releases in gaming history. The industry will undoubtedly keep a close eye on how the game performs in future award cycles once it finally lands in the hands of players and critics alike.

## Editor's Take

Missing the Golden Joysticks is simply a matter of bad timing rather than any reflection on the game itself. Award shows rely on strict submission deadlines, and when a release date falls just outside that window, participation becomes impossible. Ultimately, players care far more about the actual quality of the game when it launches than missing out on a pre-release trophy.
